original_title.why: Imprint of the Icelandic PDF: 'Aðgerðaáætlun um gervigreind 2025-2027, Júlí 2025'; the title matches character by character.

official_identifier.why: The ISBN is that of the English edition; the Icelandic edition has its own ISBN (978-9935-570-03-1). The extractor leaves the English edition's and asks.

english_version.why: The English edition carries the ministry's imprint and its own ISBN and does not call itself a translation, so 'authentic' (one of the issuer's own texts) is acceptable; the url is a stored source.

summary_claims.claim: Twenty numbered actions in five pillars (table of contents lists actions 1 to 20 under five headings)

Action 2: assessing adaptations arising from incorporating the EU AI Act through the EEA and preparing a bill (Spring 2026); Action 5 on democratic debate; Action 16 on public-sector standards (Spring 2027)

scope.note: National AI action plan whose main focus is benefit, business, education, public services and health; its safety-governance content is Action 2 (AI Act incorporation), Action 5 (democratic debate, information disorder) and Action 16 (safe public-sector use). Included with a scope note.

note: English and Icelandic plan PDFs and both ministry news items stored; the Icelandic title, July 2025, issuer and the two ISBNs confirmed. The English text letter-spaces in extraction, so script quotes match only with spacing ignored; the claims check out. EEA-Lex (efta.int, not an official-sites host) shows the AI Act still under scrutiny for incorporation. Extractor lists a 9 October 2026 working-group report as a lead; it is not a newer edition of this plan.
